messages:
Jasmin Park: hey folks! i'm Jasmin — started today on eng-platform. excited to be here. i bike in from oakridge and i am a compulsive tea enthusiast (and occasional terrible pun supplier) 🍵. quick q: where's the best place to stash a commuter bike? any pump/lock-sharing tips? also favorite local tea spots?
Avi: welcome Jasmin! there's a bike cage on B2, fob-access only after 8am. look for the blue rack by the loading dock. pump is in the eng-infra closet. tea rec: Steep & Co on 3rd — big fan. :thumbsup:
Mira Patel: welcome!!! please bring puns. we have a #bike-commute channel where folks post spare parts/rides. also we have a communal tea shelf in the kitchen — label your jars pls :)
Sam: welcome to the chaos. i keep a multi-tool at my desk for random repairs. @Jasmin Park what kind of bike do you ride? townie, road, cargo? ;)
HR-Bot: Jasmin Park added to Slack groups, payroll, benefits, and the commuter discount program. New-hire welcome lunch scheduled Fri 12:30pm — RSVP here: https://forms.company/welcome-lunch (auto-post)
Luca: we also have a hand pump by the bike cage and a patch kit in the storage cabinet. Rooftop tea hangs on Thursdays if you want to meet people in person — very low-pressure.
Avery: hi Jasmin — i work infra and can walk you through after-hours fob stuff if needed. welcome aboard!
Jasmin Park: thanks y'all!! i'll drop into #bike-commute and sign up for lunch. excited for rooftop tea. also i promise not to subject you to TOO many puns but no guarantees: 'You chai me?' 😅
Sam: loud laugh. you win. :rofl: (reaction :tada: by Mira Patel)
Mira Patel: bring your terrible puns and tea — both are appreciated here :sparkles:
